description: Large (4096-byte) but compile-time-constant stack allocation. FP-bait mirroring the real CWE-789 findings in row_413_bad.arm.elf (sub sp, sp, #8384 / #92), where the immediate is not attacker-controlled.

cases.reason: The stack allocation size (4096) is a constant immediate encoded directly in the 'sub sp, sp, #4096' instruction. No register/memory taint from any input reaches the allocation size, so CWE-789 (excessive/attacker-controlled allocation size) cannot hold regardless of what the emulator feeds as input. Only the first 10 bytes of the buffer are ever written, well within bounds.
